a: Ella levar peda kashya!
Amar lach bar peda, ema sefa: veim gillach et harishona leyom sheloshim — megalleach et hashsheniyya leyom shishshim. ella, sefa mesayyeya leh, resha — beomer shelemim.
Ulerav matna kashya sefa! amar lecha rav matna, kidkatane sefa: yom sheloshim ole lechan ulechan.
May hi — miktzat hayyom kechullo? ha amra chada zimna! mahu detema: hane mille leinyan chada nezirut, aval lishte nezirut — la, ka mashma lan.
Tenan: im gillach yom shishshim chaser echad — yatza, sheyyom sheloshim ole lo min hamminyan. bishlama lerav matna — nicha. ella levar peda lema li? ha amar sheloshim chaser echad!
Amar lach: ana name aha semachi.
Tenan: mi sheamar "hareni nazir", nitma yom sheloshim — soter et hakkol. bishlama lerav matna — nicha, ella levar peda kashya!
b: Amar lach bar peda: ema sefa, rabbi eliezer omer: eno soter ella shiva. i salka datach sheloshim bainan, nistor kullehu!
Kasavar rabbi eliezer: miktzat hayyom kechullo.

Tenan: "hareni nazir mea yom", nitma yom mea — soter et hakkol. rabbi eliezer omer: eno soter ella sheloshim yom. vei salka datach savar rabbi eliezer miktzat hayyom kechullo — nistor shiva, vei la savar miktzat hayyom kechullo — listor kullehu!

Leolam la amrinan miktzat hayyom kechullo. i hachi listor kullehu! amar resh lakish, hayeynu tama derabbi eliezer, amar kera: "zot torat hannazir beyom melot yeme nizro", hattora amra: nitma beyom melot — ten lo torat nazir.
Lema ketannae: "ad melot hayyamim",
Shomani miut "yamim" shenayim — talmud lomar: "kadosh yihye gaddel pera", en giddul sear pachot mishsheloshim, divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Rabbi yonatan omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "ad melot hayyamim", i ellu hen yamim shetztzerichin lemalloot? heve omer sheloshim.
May lav: rav matna deamar kerabbi yoshiyya, uvar peda deamar kerabbi yonatan?
Amar lecha rav matna: kulle alma sheloshim bainan, vehacha bead" vead" bakkelal peligi. rabbi yoshiyya savar: "ad" velo "ad" bakkelal. verabbi yonatan savar: "ad" vead" bakkelal.
Amar mar: i ellu hen yamim shetztzerichin lemalloot — heve omer sheloshim. veema shabbat! shabbat mi ikka chassiruta?

a: Veema shana? mi manenan leyome?! veha rabbanan dekesari amri: minnayin sheen monin yamim leshanim — shenneemar: "lechodshe hashshana", chodashim mechashshevin leshanim, velo yamim leshanim.
Mishna amar: "hareni nazir achat gedola", "hareni nazir achat ketanna", afillu: "mikkan vead sof haolam" — nazir sheloshim yom.
Gemara ammay? veha "mikkan vead sof haolam" kaamar! hachi kaamar: aricha li hada milleta kemikkan vead sof haolam.

Tenan: "hareni nazir mikkan ad makom peloni" — omdim kamma yamim mikkan vead makom peloni, pachot mishsheloshim yom — nazir sheloshim yom. veim lav — nazir keminyan hayyamim. veema hacha name: aricha li ha milleta kemikkan vead makom peloni!
Amar rava: shehechzik badderech. velihve kol parsa ufarsa! amar rav pappa: beatra dela mane parse.
Velihve kol auona veauona! mi la tenan: "hareni nazir kaafar haaretz", vechisar roshi", uchechol hayyam" — hare ze nezir olam, umegalleach echad lishloshim yom?!
Kol milleta deit bay kitztzuta la katane.
Vehatanya: "hareni nazir kol yeme chayyay", "hareni nezir olam" — hare ze nezir olam. afillu mea shana, afillu elef shanim — en ze nezir olam, ella nazir leolam.
Rabba amar: shane searot, hoil umuvedalot zo mizzo.
Gabbe yome name, ha ketiv "vayhi erev vayhi voker yom echad"!
Hatam lav demippaski mehadade hu. may kaamar — yemama velelya chad yoma hu, uleolam la mippaski mehadade.
Rava amar: lema lach akshoye kulle hay, shane hatam, deha katane "hareni nazir achat".
Mishna "hareni nazir veyom echad", "hareni nazir veshaa achat", "hareni nazir achat umechetza" — hare ze nazir shetayim.

Gemara lema li lemitna kol hane? tzerichi, dei tena "hareni nazir veyom echad", hacha hu deamrinan: en nezirut leyom echad, ammetu lehachi kamane tarten. aval "hareni nazir veshaa achat" — limne sheloshim veechad yom, ka mashma lan.
b: Vei tena "shaa achat", mishshum dela nachet ledavka. aval achat umechetza, denachet ledavka — ema la limne tarte, kamashma lan kullehu — nazir shetayim.
Mishna "hareni nazir sheloshim yom veshaa achat" — nazir sheloshim veechad yom, sheen nezirut leshaot.
Gemara amar rav: lo shanu ella deamar "sheloshim veechad yom", aval amar "sheloshim [yom] veyom echad" — nazir shetayim.
Rav savar la kerabbi akiva, dedaresh lishshana yattira.
Ditnan: lo et habbor velo et haddut — af al pi shekkatav lo umeka veruma. vetzarich likkach lo derech, divre rabbi akiva.
Vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich likkach lo derech. umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo "chutz meellu" sheeno tzarich likkach lo derech.

a: Mishna "hareni nazir kisar roshi", vechaafar haaretz", uchechol hayyam" — hare ze nezir olam, umegalleach achat lishloshim yom.
Rabbi omer: en ze megalleach achat lishloshim yom. veezehu megalleach achat lishloshim? haomer: "hare alay nezirut kisar roshi", vechaafar haaretz", uchechol hayyam".

"Hareni nazir melo habbayit", o "melo hakkuppa" — bodkin oto, im amar: achat gedola nazarti — nazir sheloshim yom. veim amar: setam nazarti — roin et hakkuppa keillu hi melea chardal, venazir kol yamav.
"Hareni nazir mikkan ad makom peloni" — omdin kamma yamim mikkan ad makom peloni, im pachot mishsheloshim yom — nazir sheloshim yom. veim lav — nazir keminyan hayyamim.
"Hareni nazir keminyan yemot hachamma" — mone nezirot keminyan yemot hachamma. amar rabbi yehuda: maase haya, kevan shehishlim — met.
Gemara roin et hakkuppa keillu melea chardal venazir kol yamav. veammay? velichzeyay keillu melea kishshuin vedilluin, vetihve leh takkanta!
Amar chizkiyya: bemachaloket shenuya. verabbi shimon hi, deamar: adam machnis et atzmo ledavar shessefeko chamur mivvadday.
Detanya: "hareni nazir al menat sheyyehe bichri ze mea kor", vehalach umetzao shennignav o sheavad — rabbi shimon oser, shessefek nezirut lehachemir.
Rabbi yehuda mattir, shessefek nezirut lehakel.
Rabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbi yehuda, hatam la nachet leh linzirut. hacha nachet leh linzirut, bemay lesallokeh minneh?
Ammay la? lichzeya lekuppa keillu melea kishshuin vedilluin, vetihve leh takkanta. ha salka datin, nezirut hu dekabbel illaveh!
b: Derabbi yehuda savar la kerabbi. ditnan, rabbi omer: en ze megalleach achat lishloshim yom. veezehu shemmegallech achat lishloshim yom? haomer "[hare] alay nezirot kisar roshi" vechaafar haaretz" uchechol hayyam".
Verabbi yehuda mi savar la kerabbi? vehatnan: hareni nazir keminyan yemot hachamma vechulei. amar rabbi yehuda: maase haya, vechevan shehishlim — met.
I amrat bishlama nezirot ka mekabbel aleh, hayeynu tama dechevan dehishlim — met. ella i amrat chada nezirut kabbel illaveh — mi have hashelama kelal?
Veod: mi savar la kerabbi? veha tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: "hareni nazir minyan hilkete kayitz", uminyan shevile shemitta" — mone nezirot keminyan hilkete kayitz ucheminyan shevile shemitta!
"Minyan" shane.

Umi shane leh lerabbi minyan? vehatanya: "hareni nazir keminyan yemot hachamma" — mone nezirot keminyan yemot hachamma. "kime hallevana" — mone kime hallevana. rabbi omer: ad sheyyomar "nezirot alay keminyan yemot hachamma ucheminyan yemot hallevana"!
Rabbi yehuda savar la kevateh bachada ufelig aleh bachada. savar la kevateh bachada — nezirut kabbel illaveh. ufelig aleh bachada — deillu rabbi yehuda shane leh mone, verabbi la shane leh mone.
Tanu rabbanan: "hareni nazir kol yeme chayyay", "hareni nezir olam" — hare ze nezir olam. afillu "mea shana", afillu "elef shanim" — en ze nezir olam, ella nazir leolam.
Tanu rabbanan: "hareni nazir veachat" — mone shetayim. "veod" — mone shalosh. "veshuv" — mone arba. peshita? mahu detema: "veshuv" ki kullehu, vehavya leh shet, ka mashma lan dela.
Tanu rabbanan: "hareni nazir" — somchos omer: "hen" — achat, "digon" — shetayim, "terigon" — shalosh, "tetragon" — arba, "pontigon" — chamesh.
Tanu rabbanan: bet iggul, digon, terigon, pontigon — eno mittamme bingaim, tetragon — mittamme bingaim. may tama? lematta hu omer "kir" "kirot". lemala hu omer "kir" "kirot". hare kan arba.
Haderan alach kol kinnuye

a: "Hareni nazir min haggerogrot umin haddevela", bet shammay omrim: nazir. uvet hillel omrim: eno nazir. amar rabbi yehuda: af kesheamru bet shammay, lo amru ella beomer "hare hen alay korban".

Gemara "hareni nazir min haggerogrot umin haddevela" — bet shammay omrim: nazir. veammay? "mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin" amar rachamana! bet shammay savri la kerabbi meir, deamar: en adam motzi devarav levattala.
Uvet hillel savri la kerabbi yose, deamar: bigmar devarav adam nitpas. vehay neder ufitcho immo hu.
Uvet shammay name, neder ufitcho immo hu!

Ella: bet shammay savri la kerabbi meir, deamar: en adam motzi devarav levattala. vechevan deamar "hareni nazir" — hava leh nazir, ki kaamar "min haggerogrot umin haddevela" — leitteshole hu dekaate. uvet shammay letamayyhu deamri: en sheela behekdesh. vechevan deen sheela behekdesh — en sheela binzirut.
Uvet hillel savri kerabbi shimon, ditnan: verabbi shimon poter, shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevim.
b: Matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya rabbi natan omer, bet shammay omrim: nadur venazir, uvet hillel omrim: nadur veen nazir. bet shammay savri la kerabbi meir ucherabbi yehuda, uvet hillel savri la kerabbi yose.
Lishshana acharina amri la: rabbi natan omer, bet shammay omrim: nadur veeno nazir, uvet hillel omrim: lo nadur velo nazir. bet shammay kerabbi yehuda uvet hillel kerabbi shimon.

Tenan hatam: haomer "hare alay mincha lehavi min hasseorim" — yavi min hachittim. "kemach" — yavi solet. "shello beshemen ulevona" — yevienna beshemen ulevona. "chatzi issaron" — yavi issaron shalem. "issaron umechetza" — yavi shenayim. rabbi shimon poter, shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevim.

Man tanna dechi amar "hare alay mincha min hasseorim" mevi min hachittim? amar chizkiyya: bemachaloket shenuya, uvet shammay hi. lav amri bet shammay ki amar "min haggerogrot umin haddevela" have nazir, hachi name ki amar "min hasseorin" — mevi min hachittim.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema divre hakkol — beomer "illu hayiti yodea sheen nodrin kach, lo nadarti kach ella kach".
Amar chizkiyya: lo shanu ella sheamar "min hasseorim", aval amar "min haadashim" — la mayyte velo kelum.
Mikkedi chizkiyya keman mokem lah lematnitin — kevet shammay, veha adashim legabbe mincha kigrogrot legabbe nazir damu, vekaamri bet shammay have nazir! hadar beh chizkiyya.
Veammay hadar beh? amar rava, matnitin keshiteh: may irya detane "min hasseorim"? litne "min haadashim"! ella savar chizkiyya: ki kaamri bet shammay hatam — kerabbi yehuda.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu "min haadashim". veha rabbi yochanan hu deamar, beomer "illu hayiti yodea sheen nodrin kach, lo nadarti kach ella kach"! lidvarav dechizkiyya hu dekaamar.

At may tama ka hadrat bach — mishshum dela katane "min haadashim". dilma la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya ki amar "meadashim", demayyte mincha meallayyta, deikka lememar mihdar hu dahadar beh, utefos lashon rishon. ella ki amar "min hasseorin", vadday dehachi kaamar: i kadsha kamminchat haomer,

a: O keminchat sota — tikdosh, i la — la. ka mashma lan demayyte min hachittim.

Mishna amar: "amra para zo hareni nezira im omedet ani", "omer haddelet hazze hareni nezira im niftach ani" — bet shammay omrim: nazir, uvet hillel omrim: eno nazir. amar rabbi yehuda: af kesheamru bet shammay, lo omrim ella beomer "hare para zo alay korban, im omedet hi".

Gemara para mi ka mishtaya? amar rame bar chama: hacha bemay askinan — kegon shehayta para revutza lefanav, veamar: "kisvura para zo enah omedet — hareni nazir mibbesarah im amda meeleha". veamda meeleha. vehalchu bet shammay leshitatan uvet hillel leshitatan.
Bet shammay deamri "min haggerogrot umin haddevela" — have nazir, hacha name, ki amar "mibbesarah" — have nazir. uvet hillel omrim: la have nazir.
Veha amruha bet shammay chada zimna! amar rava: tarte telat. vechen tane rabbi chiyyay tarte telat. vechen amar rabbi oshaya tarte telat.

Utzerichi, dei ittemar beha gerogrot udevela: hatam hu deamri bet shammay have nazir, mishshum demichallefan baanavim. aval basar baanavim — la michallaf. vei ittemar basar: hacha hu deamri bet shammay have nazir bevisra vechamra. aval gerogrot udevela — la, ka mashma lan.
Vei ittemar hane tarte: hane hu dekaamri bet shammay, aval delet ema modu lehu levet hillel. vei tanna delet: beha kaamri bet hillel, aval behach tarte ema modu lehu levet shammay, kamashma lan dela.

Amar rava: mi katane "im amda meeleha"? ella amar rava: kegon shehayta para revutza lefanav, veamar: "hare alay korban". bishlama para — bat korban hi, ella delet — bat korban hi?! ella amar rava: kegon shehayta para revutza lefanav,
b: Veamar: "hareni nazir miyyayin im lo amda", veamda meeleha. bet shammay savri: turepeh dehay gavra mishshum okoma bideh hu, veha la okma. uvet hillel savri: mishshum dirvia hu, veha kamat.
I hachi, ema sefa, amar rabbi yehuda: af kesheamru bet shammay, lo amru ella beomer "hare hen alay korban". para mi ka matpes bah midde?

Ella kegon deamar "hareni nazir mibbesarah im lo amda", veamda meeleha. bet shammay savri: turepeh dehahu gavra mishshum okoma bideh hu, veha la okma. uvet hillel savri: turepeh dehay gavra mishshum dirvia, veha kamat.
Uvet hillel savri i la kamat have nazir? vehaamri "mibbesarah" — la have nazir!

Letamayyhu devet shammay kaamri: ledidan afillu la kamat, name la have nazir. ledidchu deamritu have nazir, odo lan mihat deturepeh dehaden gavra mishshum dirvia, veha kamat. uvet shammay: lav turepeh dehay gavra mishshum okoma bideh hu, veha la okma.

a: Mishna mazgu lo et hakkos, veamar "hareni nazir mimmennu" — hare ze nazir. maase beishsha achat shehayta shikkora, umazgu lah et hakkos, veamra: "hareni nezira mimmennu". amru chachamim: lo nitkavvevna zo ella lomar "hare hu alay korban".
Gemara maase listor?! amrat resha — hare ze nazir, vahadar tane: maase beishsha achat, alma behay hu deasur, ha yena acharina — shere!

Chassore michassera vehachi katane: mazgu lo et hakkos, veamar "hareni nazir mimmennu" — hare ze nazir. veim shikkor hu, veamar "hareni nazir mimmennu" — eno nazir. may tama — keman deamar "hare alay korban" hu, vechi tema: lema hachi? savar: mayytin li acharina umetzaarin li, ema lehu ha milleta difsika lehu. umaase name beishsha achat.
Mishna "hareni nazir al menat sheehe shote yayin umittamme lemetim" — hare ze nazir, veasur bechullan.

"Yodea ani sheyyesh nezirut, aval eni yodea shehannazir asur beyayin" — hare ze asur, verabbi shimon mattir. "yodea ani shehannazir asur beyayin, aval savur hayiti shechachamim mattirin li mippene sheen ani yachol lichyot ella beyayin", o "mippene sheani kover et hammetim" — hare ze muttar, verabbi shimon oser.
Gemara veliflog name rabbi shimon beresha! amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: chaluk haya rabbi shimon af beresha.

Ravina amar: beresha la pelig rabbi shimon, may tama — mishshum dehave leh matne al ma shekkatuv battora, vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora — tenao batel. verabbi yehoshua ben levi amar lach: [hay] "al menat" — kechutz dame.

Tanya kevoteh deravina: amar "hareni nazir al menat sheehe shote yayin umittamme lemetim" — hare ze nazir veasur bechullan, mippene shehu matne al ma shekkatuv betora, vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora — tenao batel.
"Yodea ani shehannazir asur beyayin". vehaamrat resha asur, verabbi shimon mattir! ema name: hare ze asur, verabbi shimon mattir. veibbaet ema: leolam la tefoch. hatam
b: Resha, kegon dinzar mechada, lerabbanan deamri daafillu lo nazar ella meachat mehen — have nazir, veasur. lerabbi shimon deamar ad sheyyazzir mikkullam — muttar.
Sefa dindar mikkullehu, veitteshil mechada.

Lerabbanan deamri afillu lo nazar ella meachat mehen have nazir, ki mitteshil mechada minnayyhu — ishteri. lerabbi shimon deamar ad sheyyazzir mikkullam, ki mitteshil name mehahu, ad demitteshil mikkullehu. mishshum hachi katane: verabbi shimon oser.
Veibbaet ema: benidre onasin ka mippalgi, uviflugeta dishmuel verav assi. ditnan: arbaa nedarim hittiru chachamim: nidre zeruzin. nidre havay. nidre shegagot. nidre onasin.
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav assi: arbaa nedarim hallalu, tzerichin sheela lachachamim. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: tanna katane "hittiru chachamim", veat amrat tzerichin sheela lachachamim?!
Rabbanan savri kishmuel. verabbi shimon kerav assi.
Mishna "hareni nazir vealay legalleach nazir", veshama chavero veamar "vaani vealay legalleach nazir". im hayu pikchim — megallechin ze et ze. veim lav — megallechin nezirim acherim.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: shama chavero veamar "vaani", mahu? "vaani" — akkulleh dibbura mashma, o dilma appalgeh dedibbura mashma. im timtze lomar appalgeh dedibbura mashma: aresha, o assefa?

Ta shema: "vaani vealay legalleach nazir", im hayu pikchim megallechin ze et ze. middekaamar "vaani vealay" — shema minna vaani appalgeh dedibbura amri. in, appalgeh dedibbura mashma, mihu: aresha, o assefa? minna, middekaamar "vealay legalleach", shema minna: "vaani" — al techillat dibbura mashma.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: mimmay dehachi? leolam ema lach "vaani" — akkulleh dedibbura, vei mishshum "vealay", may kaamar — "vealay" beha milleta. dei la tema hachi, dekatane sefa "hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir" veshama chavero veamar "vaani alay legalleach chatzi nazir", hatam mi ikka tarten mille? ella, may kaamar: "alay" beha milleta, hacha name, ki kaamar "alay" — beha milleta.

Amar leh rava: hachi hasheta?! i amrat bishlama resha tzericha sefa la tzericha — tane sefa dela tzericha mishshum resha ditzricha. ella i amrat resha la tzericha sefa la tzericha, tane resha dela tzericha vetane sefa dela tzericha?!
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: haomer lishlucho

a: "Tze vekaddesh li ishsha" setam — asur bechol hannashim shebbaolam. chazaka shaliach ose shelichuto, vechevan dela paresh leh, ha la yada he nihu kaddesh leh.
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: ken setuma shepparcha gozal echad mehen laavir haolam, o shepparcha leven chattaot hammetot, o shemmet echad mehen — yikkach zug lashsheni.
Veillu ken meforeshet — en lo takkana.
Veillu shear kinnin bealma mittakkenan. veammay? lema kol chada vachada dilma hay nihu!
Amar leh: kaamena ana ishsha dela nayyda, veamrat li at issura denayed?
Vechi tema: hacha name nayed, emor beshuka ashkach vekaddesh, hatam hadra lenichuta, gabbe ken mi hadra?
Amar rava: umode rabbi yochanan beishsha sheen lah lo bat, velo bat bat, velo bat ben, velo em, velo em em, velo achot. veaf al pi shehayta lah achot venitgarsha leachar mikkan, dehahi sharya.
May tama — divhahi shata deka amar leh, hava nesivan legavre. ki meshavve shaliach — bemilleta dekayyma kammeh. bemilleta dela kayyma kammeh — la meshavve shaliach.

Tenan: "hareni nazir vealay legalleach nazir", veshama chavero veamar: "vaani, vealay legalleach nazir", im hayu pikchin — megallechin ze et ze, veim lav — megallechin nezirim acherim. bishlama batraa — ikka kadmaa kammeh. ella kadmaa — mi ikka batraa kammeh?
b: Ella hachi kaamar: i mashkachna dehave nazir, agallecheh. hacha name, hachi kaamar leh: i mashkachat demiggarsha, kaddesh li.
Amri: la meshavve inish shaliach ella bemilleta dematze aved hasheta, bemilleta dela matze aved leh hasheta — la meshavve.

Vela? ta shema, haomer leappotroppos shello: "kol nedarim shettiddor ishti mikkan ad sheavo mimmakom peloni — hafer lah", vehefer lah, yachol yehu mufarin — talmud lomar: "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu", divre rabbi yoshiyya. verabbi yonatan omer: matzinu bechol makom sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto.

Tama deamar rachamana "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu", ha lav hachi — appotroppos mefer. veillu gabbe dideh tanya: haomer leishto "kol nedarim shettiddori mikkan vead sheavo mimmakom peloni yehu kayyaymin" — lo amar kelum. "hare hen mufarin", rabbi eliezer omer: mufar, vachachamim omrim: eno mufar.
Ka salka datin ki amar rabbi yoshiyya — allibba derabbanan deamri la matze mefer, vei lav deamar rachamana "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu", appotroppos hava mefar.
Vedilma allibba derabbi eliezer, deamar matze mefar! i hachi, lema li leshauoye shaliach? lefar la ihu! kasavar dilma mishtelena, o ratachna, o mitteridna.

Mishna "hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir", veshama chavero veamar "vaani alay legalleach chatzi nazir" — ze megalleach nazir shalem, veze megalleach nazir shalem, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ze megalleach chatzi nazir, veze megalleach chatzi nazir.

Gemara amar rava: hakkol modim, kol hecha deamar "chatzi korbanot nazir alay" — chatzi korban mayyte. "korbenot chatzi nazir alay" — kulleh korban bae etoye. may tama — deha la ashkechan nezirut lefalga.

Vechi peligi, belishshana dematnitin peligi. rabbi meir savar: kevan deamar "hare alay" — ichayyayv akkulleh korban nezirut, vechi kaamar chatzi nezirut — lav kol keminneh. verabbanan savri: neder ufetach immo hu.

Mishna "hareni nazir lichsheyyihye li ben", venolad lo ben — hare ze nazir. nolad lo bat, tumetum, veanderoginos — eno nazir. im amar "kesheyyihye li valad" — afillu nolad lo bat, tumetum, veanderoginos — hare ze nazir.

a: Hippila ishto — eno nazir. rabbi shimon omer: yomar "im haya ben kayyayma — hare ani nezir chova, veim lav — hare ani nezir nedava".
Chazra veyalda — hare ze nazir. rabbi shimon omer: yomar "im harishon ben kayyayma — harishon chova vezo nedava. veim lav — harishon nedava vezo chova".
Gemara hay may lememra? mishshum sefa: bat, tumetum veanderoginos — eno nazir. peshita! mahu detema: "lichsheebbane" hu dekaamar, ka mashma lan dela.
Veim amar kesheyyihye li valad kulei. peshita! mahu detema valad demichashav bene inashe bainan, ka mashma lan.
Hippila ishto — eno nazir. man katane la? rabbi yehuda dichri hu.

Rabbi shimon omer: yomar "im haya ben kayyayma — hareni nezir chova, veim lav — hareni nezir nedava". bea minneh rabbi abba merav huna: "hareni nazir lichsheyyihye li ben", vehippila ishto, vehifrish korban, vechazra veyalda, mahu?
Allibba deman? i allibba derabbi shimon, may tibbee leh? ha amar rabbi shimon: sefek nezirut lehachamir. veella allibba derabbi yehuda, deamar: sefek nezirut lehakel. may: kadosh, o la kadosh?
May nafka minna! legizzato velaavod bo. teku.
Bea minneh ben rechumi meabbaye: "hareni nazir lichsheyyehe li ben", veshama chavero veamar "vealay", mahu? addibbureh mashma, o aggufeh mashma?

Im timtze lomar aggufeh mashma, amar: "hareni nazir lichsheyyehe li ben", veshama chavero veamar "vaani", mahu? annafsheh kaamar, o dilma hachi kaamar: rachemna lach kevotaych. im timtze lomar, kol beanpeh
b: Kesifa leh milleta, amar "hareni nazir lichsheyyehe lifloni ben", veshama chavero veamar "vaani", mahu? mi amrinan: shello befanav, annafsheh kaamar, o dilma hachi kaamar leh: rachemna leh kevotaych. tibbee.

Mishna "hareni nazir, venazir kesheyyihye li ben", hitchil mone et shello, veachar kach nolad lo ben — mashlim et shello, veachar kach mone et shel beno. "hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben, venazir", hitchil mone et shello veachar kach nolad lo ben — manniach et shello, umone et shel beno, veachar kach mashlim et shello.
Gemara bae rava: amar "hareni nazir leachar esrim yom, umeachshav mea yom", mahu? kevan dehalen mea beesrin la shalmin — la chayylin, o dilma: kevan deit leh giddul sear levassof — chayylin.
Vetibbee leh nezirut muetet! chada miggo chada ka mibbaya leh:

a: Im timtze lomar nezirut muetet, kevan deasra yomin hu deyattirin — la salek leh halen asara, vadday nezir mea yom, kevan deit leh temanin yomin levassof, salkin leh, o la?
Veim timtze lomar chayyli: amar "hareni nazir leachar esrim yom umeachshav nezir olam", mahu? mi chayyla aleh, o la?

Im timtze lomar: hacha kevan deefshar leitteshole chayyla: amar "hareni nezir shimshon leachar esrim yom umeachshav nazir setam", mahu? hacha la efshar leitteshole, mi chayyla, o la? amar "kemoshe beshiva baadar", may?
Peshot minnayyhu kadmayyta: "hareni nazir leachar esrim yom umeachshav mea yom" — mone esrim, veachar kach mone sheloshim, veachar kach mone shemonim kede lehashelim nezirut rishona.
Nitma bime beno, rabbi yochanan amar: soter. resh lakish amar: eno soter.
Rabbi yochanan amar soter — chada nezirut arichta hi, resh lakish amar eno soter — nezirut dideh lechud, vedivreh lechud.
b: Nitma bime tzarato — rabbi yochanan amar: soter. resh lakish amar: eno soter.
Rabbi yochanan amar soter, deha binzirut kae. resh lakish amar eno soter — tzaraat lechud unezirut lechud.
Utzericha, dei ittemar behach kammayyta, behahi amar rabbi yochanan soter — shem nezirut achat hi. aval beha ema mode leh leresh lakish, denazir lechud vetzaraat lechud.
Vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar resh lakish, aval behach — ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan, tzericha.
Nitma beyom giddul sear. rav amar: eno soter. afillu lerabbi yochanan deamar soter — hane mille hecha dekae binzirut, giddul sear mishlam nezirut hu.
Ushemuel amar: soter. afillu leresh lakish deamar en soter — hatam shete nezirut, hacha chada neziruta.
Amar rav chisda: hakkol modim sheim kiddesh sear baddam — en lo takkana.

Allibba deman? i allibba derabbi eliezer — kevan deamar tiglachat meakkevet, toch melot hi? velistor! ella allibba derabbanan — haamri tiglachat lo meakkevet! leolam allibba derabbanan, umay "en lo takkana" — en lo takkana lemitzvat gilluach.

Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: nazir shekkalu lo yamav — loke al hattumea, veeno loke al hattiglachat velo al hayyayin. may shena tumea delake — deamar kera: "kol yeme hazziro laAdonai", lerabbot yamim shelleachar melot keyamim shellifne melot.

I hachi, attiglachat name lichayyayv, deha amar rachamana "kol yeme neder nizro taar lo yaavor al rosho", laasot yamim shelleachar melot kayyamim shellifne melot! vetu, "kol yeme nizro mikkol asher yease miggefen hayyayin", laasot yamim shelleachar melot keyamim shellifne melot?

a: Shane hacha deamar rachamana: "vetimme rosh nizro", mi shennizro taluy lo berosho. metivi: nazir shekkalu lo yamav — asur legalleach velishtot yayin velittame lemetim, veim gillach veshata yayin venitma lemetim — hare ze sofeg et haarbaim. teyuveta.
Mishna "hareni nazir lichsheyyehe li ben" venazir mea yom", nolad lo ben ad shivim — lo hifsid kelum. leachar shivim — soter shivim. sheen tiglachat pachot mishsheloshim yom.

Gemara amar rav: yom shivim ole lechan ulechan. tenan: nolad lo ad shivim — lo hifsid kelum. vei salka datach ola lechan ulechan, ittegore mittegar! ella bedin hu dela litne "ad shivim", umishshum dekatane sefa "achar shivim soter shivim", katane resha "shivim".
Ta shema missefa: nolad achar shivim — soter shivim. may "achar"? achar achar.

Aval achar mammash may — hachi name dela satar? i hachi, may irya detane nolad ad shivim lo hifsid kelum? afillu achar shivim name, ha amrat la satar! ella shema minna "achar" mammash. vechen matnitin lerav, shema minna.
Verav keman amra lishmateh? illema keabba shaul, ditnan: hakkover et meto shelosha yamim kodem laregel — batla mimmennu gezerat shiva.
Shemona yamim kodem laregel — batla mimmennu gezerat sheloshim. umuttar lesapper erev haregel, veim lo sipper erev haregel — asur lesapper achar haregel.
b: Abba shaul omer: afillu lo sipper kodem haregel — muttar lesapper achar haregel, shekkeshem shemmitzvat shelosha mevattelet gezerat shiva — kach mitzvat shiva mevattelet gezerat sheloshim.
May tama deabba shaul? lav mishshum dekasavar shevii ole lechan ulechan? dilma ad kan la kaamar abba shaul ella baavelut shiva derabbanan, aval benazir deorayyta — la!
Ella rav deamar kerabbi yose. detanya, rabbi yose omer: shomeret yom keneged yom sheshshachatu vezarku aleha bashsheni shellah,
Veachar kach raata — hare zo enah ochelet, ufetura millaasot pesach sheni.
May tama derabbi yose, lav mishshum dekasavar miktzat hayyom kechullo? mimmay? vedilma mishshum dekasavar mikkan ulehabba hu metamme.
Umi savar rabbi yose hachi?

Vehatanya, rabbi yose omer: zav baal shete reiyyot sheshshachatu vezarku alav bashshevii, vechen shomeret yom keneged yom sheshshachatu vezarku aleha, veachar kach rau, af al pi shemmetammein mishkav umoshav lemafrea — peturin millaasot pesach sheni.
May lemafrea — midderabbanan. hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach middeorayyta, ammay peturin millaasot pesach sheni?
Leolam ema lach tumea deorayyta, tehom deziva hittiru.
Veaf rabbi oshaya savar lemafrea midderabbanan, detanya, rabbi oshaya amar: (aval) haroe zav bashshevii shello — soter et shellefanav. vaamar leh rabbi yochanan: la nistor ella yomo.
Ma nafshach? i satar, kullehu satar. i la satar — la nistor velo yomo! ella ema: la nistor vela yomo.

a: Vaamar leh: rabbi yose kae kevataych, deamar mikkan ulehabba metamme. veha rabbi yose lemafrea hu deamar! may lemafrea — midderabbanan.

Verabbi yose, mikkedi savar miktzat hayyom kechullo, zava gemura demayyta korban hechi mashkachat lah? kevan dechazya befalgeh deyoma, iddach palgeh deyoma salek la leshimmur! ibbaet ema deka shafa telata telata yome bahade hadade. veibbaet ema: dechazya telata yome samuch lishkiat hachamma, dela havay shehut desalek leh leminyayna.
Haderan alach hareni nazir
Mi sheamar "hareni nazir" — megalleach yom sheloshim veechad, veim gillach leyom sheloshim — yatza. "hareni nazir sheloshim yom" — im gillach leyom sheloshim lo yatza.

Mi shennazar shete nezirot — megalleach et harishona yom sheloshim veechad, veet hashsheniyya yom shishshim veechad. veim gillach et harishona yom sheloshim — megalleach et hashsheniyya yom shishshim, veim gillach yom shishshim chaser echad — yatza.

Vezo edut heid rabbi pappeyays, al mi shennazar shete nezirot, sheim gillach et harishona yom sheloshim — megalleach et hashsheniyya leyom shishshim, veim gillach leyom shishshim chaser echad — yatza, sheyyom shel sheloshim ole lo min hamminyan.

Mi sheamar "hareni nazir", nitma yom sheloshim — soter et hakkol. rabbi eliezer omer: eno soter ella shiva. "hareni nazir sheloshim yom", nitma yom sheloshim — soter et hakkol. "hareni nazir mea yom", nitma yom mea — soter et hakkol. rabbi eliezer omer: eno soter ella sheloshim. nitma yom mea veechad — soter sheloshim yom. rabbi eliezer omer: eno soter ella shiva.
Gemara mi sheamar "hareni nazir" venitma yom sheloshim — soter et hakkol, rabbi eliezer omer: eno soter ella shiva.
b: Kasavar rabbi eliezer: kol achar melot shiva — soter. "hareni nazir sheloshim yom", venitma yom sheloshim — soter et hakkol, la pelig rabbi eliezer deamar shelemin.
"Hareni nazir mea yom", venitma yom mea — soter et hakkol, rabbi eliezer omer: eno soter ella sheloshim. vechullah kedahavenan bah allibba devar padda verav matna.
Mishna mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot, afillu haya sham sheloshim yom — en olin lo min hamminyan, veeno mevi korban tumea. yatza venichnas — olin lo min hamminyan, umevi korban tumea.
Rabbi eliezer omer: lo bo vayyom, shenneemar: "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu", ad sheyyehu lo yamim rishonim.

Gemara ittemar, mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot, rabbi yochanan amar: nezirut chala alav, veresh lakish amar: en nezirut chala alav. rabbi yochanan amar nezirut chala alav, savar: mittela talya vekayyma, kevan demashkecha tohora, chayyla. veresh lakish amar: en nezirut chala alav. i hadar veamar — chayyla aleh, vei la — la.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot, afillu haya sham sheloshim yom — en olin min hamminyan, veeno mevi korban tumea. korban tumea hu dela mayyte, ha mechal — chayyla aleh! amar leh: eno betorat tumea, veeno betorat korban.

Etiveh: mi shehaya tame venazar, asur legalleach velishtot yayin velittame lemetim. veim gillach veshata yayin venitma lemetim — hare ze sofeg et haarbaim. i amrat bishlama chayyla — hayeynu tama desofeg et haarbaim, ella i amrat la chayyla, ammay sofeg et haarbaim?

a: Hacha bemay askinan — beyotze venichnas.

Etiveh: en ben tame shennazar lenazir tahor shennitma, ella tame shennazar — shevii shello ole lo lamminyan, venazir tahor shennitma — en shevii shello ole lo lamminyan. vei salka datach la chayyla, ammay ole lo min hamminyan?
Amar mar bar rav ashe: mechal — kulle alma la peligi dechayyla, ella ki peligi lemilke: rabbi yochanan savar: kevan dechayyla — lake. veresh lakish savar: la lake, vechayyla.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot, afillu haya sham sheloshim yom — en olin lo min hamminyan, veeno mevi korban tumea. korban tumea hu dela mayyte, ha milke, lake aleh!
Bedin hu delitne "eno loke", ella mishshum deka bae lemitne sefa "yatza venichnas — ole lo min hamminyan, umevi korban tumea", tena resha "eno mevi korban tumea".

Ta shema: en ben tame shennazar lenazir tahor shennitma, ella shettame shennazar — shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan, venazir tahor shennitma — en shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan. ha lemalkut — ze vaze shavin! amar leh: la, letiglachat ze vaze shavin.
Aval leinyan malkot may — ze loke veze eno loke? litneyeh! betakkanteh ka mayyre, bekilkuleh la ka mayyre.
Ta shema: mi shehaya tame venazar — asur legalleach velishtot yayin, veim gillach veshata yayin venitma lemetim — hare ze sofeg et haarbaim! teyuveta.
Bae rava: nazir vehu bevet hakkevarot, mahu? bae shehiyyay lemalkut, o la?
Hechi dame? illema deamri leh "la tinzor", lema li shehiyyay? nazir may tama la bae shehiyyay — deka matri beh. hacha name ka matri beh!
b: Ella: kegon shennichnas beshidda teva umigdal, uva chavero ufara mealav maaziva.
Ki gemirin shehiyyay, bevet hammikdash, aval abbaray — la. o dilma la shena? teku.
Bae rav ashe: nazar vehu bevet hakkevarot, taun gilluach, o la? ki bae tiglachat tahor shennitma, deka metamme linziruteh, aval tame shennazar — la. o dilma la shena?

Ta shema: mi shennazar vehu bevet hakkevarot, afillu haya sham sheloshim yom — eno ole lo min hamminyan, veeno mevi korban tumea. korban tumea hu dela mayyte, aval galloche bae! "ma taam" kaamar: ma taam eno mevi korban tumea — mishshum dela bae galloche.

Ta shema: en ben tame shennazar lenazir tahor shennitma, ella tame shennazar — shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan, venazir tahor shennitma — en shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan. may lav, ha letiglachat ze vaze shavin? la: ha lemalkut ze vaze shavin.
Aval tiglachat may — ze megalleach, veze eno megalleach? litneyeh! tena shevii shello vechol mille.

Ta shema: en li ella yeme tumeato sheen olin lo min hamminyan, yeme chilluto, minnayin? vedin hu: ma yeme tumeato megalleach umevi korban — af yeme chilluto megalleach umevi korban, uma yeme tumeato en olin lo min hamminyan — af yeme chilluto en olin lo min hamminyan.
Lo, im amarta bime tumeato, shekken mevattel bahen et hakkodmin — lefichach en olin lo min hamminyan, tomar bime chilluto, sheeno mevattel et hakkodmin — lefichach olin lo min hamminyan.
Amarta: uma nazir bekever shessearo rauy letiglachat — en olin lo min hamminyan, yeme chilluto sheen rauy letiglachat, lo kol shekken sheen olin lo min hamminyan?
May lav, tiglachat tumea? la, tiglachat tohora. hachi name mistabbera,

a: Dei salka datach tiglachat tumea, yeme chilluto mi la bae tiglachat? la, tiglachat dinzirut katane.
Ta shema: "vetimme rosh nizro", betahor shennitma hakkatuv medabber, shehu taun haavarat sear vahavaat tzipporin. veliftor et hannazir bekever — sheen taun haavarat sear vahavaat tzipporin.
Vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma tahor shennitma — taun haavarat sear vahavaat tzipporin, mi shehaya tame mittechilla — eno din sheyyehe taun haavarat sear vahavaat tzipporin?
Talmud lomar: "vetimme rosh nizro", bemi shehaya tahor venitma hakkatuv medabber, sheyyehe taun haavarat sear vahavaat tzipporin, veliftor et hannazir bekever. shema minna.

Man tena ha detanu rabbanan: en ben tame shennazar lenazir tahor shennitma, ella shettame shennazar — shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan, venazir tahor shennitma — en shevii shello ole lo min hamminyan?
Amar rav chisda: rabbi hi, deamar rabbi: en nezirut tohora chala ella ad shemini. dei tema rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, haamar nezirut detohora mishshevii hu dechayyla.
May rabbi umay rabbi yose berabbi yehuda — detanya: "vekiddash et rosho bayyom hahu" — beyom havaat korbenotav, divre rabbi. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: beyom tiglachto.

Veha ditnan: nazir shennitma tumeot harebe — eno mevi ella korban echad, man tanna? amar rav chisda: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, deamar: nezirut tohora mishshevii chayyla. umashkachat la kegon shennitma bashshevii, vechazar venitma bashshevii. (umanni, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi) kevan delo yatza shaa haruya lehavi korban — eno chayyayv ella korban echad.

Dei tema rabbi hi, i denitma bashshevii, vechazar venitma bashshevii (vechazar venitma bashshevii) — kullehu tumea arichta hi. vei denitma bashshemini, vechazar venitma bashshemini — hare yatzta shaa sheruya lehavi korban.
May tama derabbi? amar kera "vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh", vahadar "vekiddash et rosho". verabbi yose berabbi yehuda: im ken — lema kera: "vekiddash et rosho".
b: "Beyom hahu" lema li? im eno inyan lishmini, tenehu inyan lishvii. verabbi name, hachtiv "bayyom hahu"? amar lecha rabbi: hahu lehachi hu daata — lomar lach: af al pi shello hevi korbenotav.
Verav chisda, may duchekeh leokomay kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda? lokma kegon denitma dechazya belel shemini, verabbi hi!
Middela mokem la kerabbi, lema kasavar lelya lav mechussar zeman hu?

Amar rav adda bar ahava: ha beha talya. i amrat lelya mechussar zeman, emat michze lekorban — letzafra, nezirut name la chayyla ad tzafra. vei amrat lelya eno mechussar zeman — nezirut tohora chayyla meureta.

Gufa: nitma bashshevii, vechazar venitma bashshevii — eno mevi ella korban echad. nitma bashshemini, vechazar venitma bashshemini — mevi korban al kol echad veechad. matchil umone miyyad, divre rabbi eliezer.
Vachachamim omrim: korban echad al hakkol, ad sheyyavi chattato. hevi chattato venitma, vehevi chattato venitma — mevi korban al kol echad veechad. hevi chattato velo hevi ashamo — mone.
Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: keshem shechattato ikkevattu, ken ashamo meakkevo.
Bishlama lerabbi eliezer, amar kera "vekiddash et rosho bayyom hahu" — af al pi shello hevi korbenotav. verabbanan: "hahu" — af al pi shello hevi ashamo.
Ella rabbi yishmael, "hahu" lema li? amar lach: "hahu" — af al pi shello hevi olato. verabbanan: ola la bae miuta — doron bealma hu.

May tamayyhu derabbanan? detanya: "vehizzir laAdonai et yeme nizro vehevi keves ben shenato leasham", ma talmud lomar? lefi shemmatzinu shekkol ashamot shebbattora shehen meakkevin, yachol af ze meakkevo —

a: Talmud lomar: "vehizzir ... vehevi", af al pi shello hevi — hizzir. rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: "vehizzir ... vehevi", ematay hizzir — bizman shehevi.
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: ishsha shennadra benazir venitmea, veachar kach hefer lah baalah — mevia chattat haof, veenah mevia olat haof.
Amar rav chisda: rabbi yishmael hi.

May kasavar? i kasavar baal mikar akar — chattat haof name la layyte. i kasavar baal miggaz gayez, olat haof name layyte! leolam kasavar baal mikar akar, verabbi yishmael savar la kerabbi elazar hakkappar.

Detanya, rabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi omer: ma talmud lomar "vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh"? vechi beezo nefesh chata ze? ella shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin. vekal vachomer: uma ze shello tzier atzmo ella min hayyayin nikra chote, hametzaer atzmo mikkol davar al achat kamma vechamma.
Veha benazir tame ketiv, vaanan afillu nazir tahor kaamrinan! kasavar rabbi elazar hakkappar nazir tahor name chote hu, vehayeynu tama dichtiv benazir tame — hoil veshana bachet.
Yatza venichnas — olin lo min hamminyan. katane olin lo min hamminyan. mishshum deyatza chal aleh nezirut? amar shemuel: kegon sheyyatza vehizza veshana vetaval.
Ella nichnas hu deolin lo min hamminyan, lo nichnas en olin lo min hamminyan?! la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya yatza, ella afillu nichnas — olin lo min hamminyan.
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: may tama la mefarshat lan kehalen mille? amar lehon: amena dilma la tzerichitu.

Rabbi eliezer omer: lo bo beyom — shenneemar: "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu" — ad sheyyihyu yamim rishonim. amar ulla: la amar rabbi eliezer ella betame shennazar, aval bannazir tahor shennitma — afillu yom echad soter.
b: Amar rava: may tama derabbi eliezer? amar kera: "ki tame nizro" — mishshum divtumea nezar.
Etiveh abbaye: "hareni nazir mea yom", venitma bitchillat mea, yachol yehe soter, talmud lomar: "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu" — ad sheyyehu lo yamim rishonim, veze en lo rishonim.

Nitma besof mea, yachol yehe soter, talmud lomar: "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu" — mikkelal deikka acharonim, veze en lo acharonim. nitma beyom mea chaser achat, yachol lo yehe soter, talmud lomar: "vehayyamim harishonim yippelu" — mikkelal deikka acharonim, veze yesh lo rishonim veacharonim.
Veha, betame shennazar la matzet amrat, middekatane "hareni nazir mea", venitma bitchillat mea, vekatane "ad sheyyehu lo yamim rishonim", teyuveta.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: halen yamim dekaamrinan, denafek chad umatchilin teren, o dilma denafkin teren umatchilin telata? la hava bideh, ata shayyleh lerava. amar leh: "yippelu" ketiv.

Veitzterich lemichtav "yamim" veitzterich lemichtav "yippelu", dei ketav rachamana "yamim" vela ketav "yippelu", hava amena: ad denafkin teren veayylin telata, ketav rachamana "yippelu". vei ketav "yippelu" vela ketav "yamim", hava amena afillu chad, ketav rachamana "yamim".
Mishna mi shennazar nezirut harebe, vehishlim et neziruto, veachar kach ba laaretz, bet shammay omrim: nazir sheloshim yom, uvet hillel omrim: nazir battechilla.

Maase beheleni hammalka shehalach benah lemilchama, veamra: im yavo beni min hammilchama beshalom — ehe nezira sheva shanim. uva benah min hammilchama, vehayta nezira sheva shanim, uvesof sheva shanim alta laaretz, vehoruha bet hillel shettehe nezira od sheva shanim acherot. uvesof sheva shanim nitmet. venimtzet nezira esrim veachat shana. amar rabbi yehuda: lo hayta nezira ella arba esre shana.
Gemara katane resha: bet shammay omrim: nazir sheloshim yom, uvet hillel omrim: nazir battechilla. lema beha kamippalgi, devet shammay savri: eretz haammim mishshum gushah gazru aleha,

a: Uvet hillel savri: mishshum avvera gazru aleha? la, dechulle alma mishshum gushah gazru aleha, uvet shammay savri bistam nezirut kanesna, uvet hillel savri: ki kanesna — bitchillat nezirut.
Maase beheleni hammalka vechulei. ibbaya lehu: beshennitmet, veallibba devet shammay? o dilma beshello nitmet, veallibba devet hillel?

Ta shema: alta laaretz, vehoruha bet hillel shettehe nezira od sheva shanim acherot vechulei. vei salka datach beshennitmet veallibba devet shammay, i hachi, "rabbi yehuda omer lo hayta nezira ella arba esre shana"? "arba esre shana usheloshim yom" mibbee leh!
Tanya name hachi, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: deamar kera "zot torat hannazir", hattora amra: ki nitma beyom melot — ten lo torat nazir.

Mishna mi shehayu shete kitte edim meidot oto, ellu meidim shennazar shetayim, veellu meidim shennazar chamesh, bet shammay omrim: nechleka haedut — veen kan nezirut, uvet hillel omrim: yesh bichlal chamesh shetayim, sheyyehe nazir shetayim.

Gemara matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al shete kitte edim, achat omeret shetayim, veachat omeret chamesh, sheyyesh bichlal chamesh shetayim. al ma nechleku — al kat achat, echad omer shetayim, veechad omer chamesh, shebbet shammay omrim: nechleka edutan. uvet hillel omrim: yesh bichlal chamesh shetayim.

Amar rav: hakkol modim bemone. amar leh rav chama lerav chisda: may kaamar? illema: echad omer chamesh velo shetayim, veechad omer shetayim velo chamesh — ha ka machchashi ahadade! ella: echad omer achat ushetayim, veechad omer shalosh arba chamesh.
b: Ha lema li? hasheta yesh lomar: chamirta amar rav, killeta la amar?! amri bemareva: en hachechasha bemone.
Haderan alach mi sheamar

Mi sheamar "hareni nazir" veshama chavero veamar "vaani", "vaani" — kullam nezirim. huttar harishon — hutteru kullan. huttar haacharon — haacharon muttar vechullam asurin. amar "hareni nazir", veshama chavero veamar "pi kefiv useari kisaro" — hare ze nazir.

"Hareni nazir", veshama ishto veamra "vaani" — mefer et shellah, veshello kayyaym. "hareni nezira", veshama baalah veamar "vaani" — eno yachol lehafer. "hareni nazir veat", veamra "amen" — mefer et shellah, veshello kayyaym. "hareni nezira veatta", veamar "amen" — eno yachol lehafer.

Gemara yatev resh lakish kammeh derabbi yehuda nesia veyatev vekaamar: vehu shehitpisu kullan betoch kede dibbur. vechamma toch kede dibbur — kede sheelat shalom, vechamma kede sheelat shalom — kede sheomer shalom talmid larav.
Amar leh: tuv la shavkat ravvcha letalmida!

a: Tanya name hachi: mi sheamar "hareni nazir", veshama chavero veshaha kede dibbur, veamar "vaani" — hu asur, vachavero muttar. vechamma kede dibbur — kede sheelat shalom talmid larav.
Lema mesayyeya leh: mi sheamar "hareni nazir", veshama chavero veamar "vaani" "vaani", vetu la! tanna ki rochla lichshoyv velezil?!

Velitne chad velashmeinan hane! hacha name, umishshum dekatane sefa huttar harishon hutteru kullan, huttar haacharon — haacharon muttar vechullan asurin, mikkelal deikka emtzai, umishshum hachi katane "vaani" "vaani".

Ibbaya lehu: chad bechavreh mittefis, o dilma bekamma mittafsi? lemay nafka minna — leittefose umezal. i amrat chad bechavreh mittefis — mittafsin veazlin leolam. vei amrat bekamma mittafsi — tefe mikkede dibbur la mittafsin. may?

Ta shema: "hareni nazir", veshama chavero veamar "vaani" "vaani", vetu la midde, shema minna bekamma hu demittafsi, dei salka datach chad bechavreh mittefis — litne tuva "vaani"! tanna ki rochla lichshoyv velezil?!

Velitne chad velashmeinan kullehon! ayyeyde dekatane huttar harishon — hutteru kullan, huttar haacharon — haacharon muttar vechullan asurin, mikkelal deikka emtzai, mishshum hachi katane "vaani" "vaani".
Ta shema: huttar harishon — hutteru kullan. rishon hu dishru, ha emtzai la, shema minna bekamma mittafsin.
Ema lach: leolam chad bechavreh mittefis. veayyeyde devae mitne "hutteru kullan", dei tena emtzai, ikka rishon dela mishtere, mishshum hachi katane rishon.
Ta shema: huttar haacharon — haacharon muttar vechullan asurin. dela ikka acharina batreh, aval emtzai, deikka acharina batreh — mishtere. shema minna chad bechavreh mittefis.
Leolam ema lach: bekamma mittafsin, umay "acharon" dekatane — emtzai, veayyeyde ditna rishon, tena acharon.

Ta shema, detanya behedya: huttar harishon — hutteru kullan, huttar haacharon — haacharon muttar vechullan asurin, huttar emtzai — hemennu ulematta muttar, hemennu ulemala — asur, shema minna chad bechavreh mittefis, shema minna.
"Hareni nazir", veshama chavero veamar "pi kefiv useari kisaro vechulei". mishshum deamar "pi kefiv useari kisaro" hare nazir?
b: Ureminhu: "yadi nezira" veragli nezira" — lo amar kelum, "roshi nezira", "kevedi nezira" — hare ze nazir. ze hakkelal: davar shehanneshama teluya bo — hare ze nazir.
Amar rav yehuda, deamar hachi: yease pi kefiv miyyayin, useari kisaro millagoz.
"Hareni nezira", veshama balah vaamar "vaani" eno yachol lehafer. ibbaya lehu: baal mikar akar, o dilma miggaz gayez? lemay nafka minna —

Leishsha shennadra benazir, veshama chavertah veamra "vaani", veshama balah shel rishona vehefer lah. i amrat mikar akar — hahi name ishteray. vei amrat miggaz gayez — ihi ishteray, chaverta asira. may?
Ta shema: "hareni nezira" veshama balah veamar "vaani" — eno yachol lehafer. vei salka datach baal miggaz gayez — lefar leishto vehu littesar. ella lav shema minna, baal mikar akar.

La, leolam miggaz gayez. uvedin hu delefar la. vehayeynu tama dela matze mefar, kevan deamar la "vaani", keman deamar "kayyaym lichi" dame. i mitteshil ahakamato, — matze mefar, vei la — la matze mefar.
Ta shema: haishsha shennadra benazir, vehifrisha et behemtah, veachar kach hefer lah balah, im shello hayta habbehema — tetze vetire baeder. veim shellah hayta habbehema — hachattat tamut.
Vei salka datach baal mikar akar — tippok lechullin! ella lav shema minna, baal miggaz gayez!
Leolam ema lach baal mikar akar, vehayeynu tama: kevan delo tzericha kappara, havat kechattat shemmetu bealeha, ugemiri dechattat shemmetu bealeha — tamut.
Ta shema: haishsha shennadra benazir, vehayta shota yayin umittammea lemetim — hare zo sofeget et haarbaim. hechi dame? illema dela hefar la baal — tzericha lememar?
Ella peshita dehefar la baal. vei salka datach baal mikar akar — ammay sofeget arbaim? ella lav shema minna, baal miggaz gayez?
Leolam ema lach baal mikar akar, umishshum dekatane sefa: hefer lah balah vehi lo yada, vehayta shota yayin umittammea lemetim — enah sofeget et haarbaim,

a: Tena name resha sofeget.
Ta shema: haishsha shennadra benazir venitmet, veachar kach hefer lah baalah — mevia chattat haof, veenah mevia olat haof. vei salka datach baal miggaz gayez — tayyte name olat haof!
Veella may, mikar akar? chattat haof name la tayyte! hachi name, veha manni — rabbi elazar hakkappar hi.

Detanya, rabbi elazar hakkappar (bar rabbi) omer: ma talmud lomar "measher chata al hannafesh"? vechi beezo nefesh chata ze? ella mippene shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin nikra chote. vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma ze shello tzier atzmo ella min hayyayin nikra chote, hametzaer atzmo mikkol davar — al achat kamma vechamma.
Ta shema, detanya behedya: haishsha shennadra benazir, veshama chavertah veamra "vaani", uva balah shel rishona vehefer lah — hi mutteret vachavertah asura. shema minna: baal miggaz gayez.
Rabbi shimon omer: im amra lah "hareni kemotech" — shetehen muttarot.
b: Mar zutera bereh derav mari amar: hay, hayeynu derami bar chama. devae rame bar chama: "hare alay kivsar zevach shelamim", mahu?
Ki matpes inish, beikkara matpes, o dilma bitznana matpes?

Mi dame? hatam kevan deamar "hare alay kivsar zevach shelamim", af al gav dilachar shennizrak damo matze achel leh bachutz, mikdash kadesh. aval hacha, i salka datach bitznana ka matpes — ha hefer lah balah! ikka deamri, hayeynu derame bar chama vadday.
Amra lah, "hareni nezira beikvech", mahu? "hareni beikvech" — becholla milleta, vesharya. o dilma kemikkamme delefar la bala, vaasira?
Ta shema: haishsha shennadra benazir, veshama balah veamar "vaani" — eno yachol lehafer. vei salka datach ki amar la "hareni beikvech" — beikkara ka matpes, lefar la ledida velokem dideh.
Ella lav, shema minna becholla demilleta matpes, vehilkach hu dela matze mefar. ha ishsha deamra "hareni beikvech", hi name mutteret!
La, leolam beikkara matpes, vehacha kevan deamar la "vaani" — keomer "kayyaym lichi" dame. vei mitteshil ahakamato — matze mefar, vei la — la.
"Hareni nazir veat", veamra "amen" — mefer et shellah, veshello kayyaym. ureminhu: "hareni nazir veat", veamra "amen" — shenehem asurin, veim lav — shenehem muttarin, mippene shettala nidro benidrah.
Amar rav yehuda, teni: "mefer et shellah veshello kayyaym". abbaye amar: afillu tema kidkatane, barayyta kegon dekaamar la: "hareni nazir veat", deka tale nidro benidrah.

a: Umatnitin kegon daamar la "hareni nazir, veat may?" mishshum hachi, mefer et shellah veshello kayyaym.

Mishna haishsha shennadra benazir, vehayta shote beyayin umittammea lemetim — hare ze sofeget et haarbaim. hefer lah balah, vehi lo yada shehefer lah balah, vehayta shota beyayin umittammea lemetim — enah sofeget et haarbaim. rabbi yehuda omer: im enah sofeget et haarbaim — tispog makkat mardut.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "ishah haferam vaAdonai yislach lah" — beishsha shehefer lah balah vehi lo yada hakkatuv medabber, shehi tzericha kappara uselicha.

Ucheshehaya maggia rabbi akiva etzel pasuk ze, haya boche: uma mi shennitkavvevn laalot beyado besar chazir, veala beyado besar tale — taun kappara uselicha. hammitkavvevn laalot beyado besar chazir veala beyado besar chazir — al achat kamma vechamma.
Kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "velo yada veashem venasa avono",

Uma mi shennitkavvevn laalot beyado besar tale, veala beyado besar chazir, kegon chaticha safek shel shumman safek shel chelev — amar kera "venasa avono". mi shennitkavvevn laalot beyado besar chazir, veala beyado besar chazir — al achat kamma vechamma.

Isi ben yehuda omer: "velo yada veashem venasa avono", uma mi shennitkavvevn laalot beyado besar tale, veala beyado besar chazir, kegon shete chatichot achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman — "venasa avono". hammitkavvevn laalot beyado besar chazir, veala beyado besar chazir — al achat kamma vechamma.
Al davar ze yidvu haddovim.

Vechol hane lema li? tzerichin, dei tena gabbe ishsha, hatam hu devaaya kappara uselicha — mishshum demeikkara leissura ikkavevn. aval chaticha safek shel chelev safek shel shumman, dilhettera ikkavven — la bae kappara uselicha.
Vei ittemar hada — deikka issura. aval ishsha dehefer lah balah, dehettera — la tive kappara uselicha.

Vei ittemar hane tarte, hava amena: hane tarte hu desaggi lehon bechappara uselicha — dela ikkeva issura. aval shete chatichot achat shel chelev veachat shel shumman, deikkeva issura — la saggi leh bechappara uselicha, ka mashma lan dela shena.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam" — mashal lishne bene adam shetztzalu et pischehen, echad achalo leshum mitzva, veechad achalo leshum achila gassa. ze sheachalo leshum mitzva — "vetzaddikim yelchu vam". veze sheachalo leshum achila gassa — "ufoshim yikkashlu vam".

Amar leh resh lakish: hay "rasha" karet leh?! nehi dela ka aved mitzva min hammuvechar, pesach miha ka aved! ella: mashal lishne bene adam, ze ishto vaachoto immo, veze ishto vaachoto immo. leze nizdammena lo ishto, uleze nizdammena lo achoto. ze shennizdammena lo ishto — "tzaddikim yelchu vam", veze shennizdammena lo achoto — "ufoshim yikkashlu vam".

Mi dame? anan kaamrinan chada derech. hacha — shene derachim. ella, mashal lelot ushete venotav immo. hen shennitkavvevnu leshem mitzva — "vetzaddikim yelchu vam", hu shennitkavven leshem avera — "ufoshim yikkashlu vam".
Vedilma hu name leshum mitzva ikkavvevyn? amar rabbi yochanan: kol happasuk hazze al shem avera neemar.
"Vayyissa lot" — "vattissa eshet adonav et eneha". ["et enav" —] "ki hi yashra veenay".

"Vayyar" — "vayyar otah shechem ben chamor". "et kol kikkar hayyarden" — "ki vead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem". "ki chullah mashke" — "elcha achare meahavay notne lachmi umemay tzamri ufishti shamni veshikkuyay".
Veha menas anis! tana mishshum rabbi yose bar rav choni: lamma nakud al vav "uvekumah" shel bechira, lomar shebbeshichvah la yada, aval bekumah yada.
Umay hava leh lemibad? may dahava hava! nafka minna, dilfanya acharina la ibbei lemishte chamra.
Daresh rava: may dichtiv "ach nifsha mikkiryat oz
b: Umidyanim kivriach armon"? "ach nifsha mikkiryat oz" — ze lot, shepperash meavraham. "umidyanim kivriach armon" — shehetil midyanim kivrichin vearmon, "lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai".

Daresh rava veittema rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "letaava yevakkesh nifrad uvechol tushiyya yitgalla"? "letaava yevakkesh nifrad" — ze lot, "uvechol tushiyya yitgalla" — shennitgalla kelono bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot. ditnan: ammoni umoavi asurin, veissuran issur olam.
Amar ulla: tamar zinneta, zimri zinna.
Tamar zinneta — yatzu mimmenna melachim uneviim. zimri zinna — naflu alav kamma revavot miyyisrael.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: gedola avera lishmah mimmitzva shello lishmah. vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam betora uvemitzvot afillu shello lishman, shemmittoch shello lishman ba lishman?
Ella ema: kemitzva shello lishmah. dichtiv: "tevorach minnashim yael eshet chever hakkeni minnashim baohel tevorach". man nashim shebbaohel — sara rivka rachel velea.
Amar rabbi yochanan: sheva beilot baal oto rasha beotah shaa, shenneemar: "ben ragleha kara nafal shachav vegomer".
Veha ka mithanya mibbeila dileh? amar rabbi yochanan: kol tovatan shel reshaim — enah ella raa etzel tzaddikim,
Shenneemar: "hishshamer lecha middabber im yaakov mittov vead ra". bishlama ra — shappir, ella tov ammay la? ella, lav shema minna: tovato — raa hi. shema minna.

Gufa, amar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam betora uvemitzvot afillu shello lishman, shemmittoch shello lishman ba lishman. shebbischar arbaim ushenayim korbanot shehikriv balak harasha — zacha veyatza mimmennu rut. veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: rut, bat beno shel eglon melech moav hayta.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin sheen hakkadosh baruch hu mekappeach afillu sechar sicha naa, deillu bechira dikrayteh moav, amar leh rachamana "al tatzar et moav veal titgar vam milchama". milchama hu dela, aval tzaore tzaarinnun.
Veillu tzeira dikrayteh ben ammi. amar leh: "al tetzurem veal titgar vam". afillu tzaore, la tetzaarinnun kelal.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin, amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: leolam yakdim adam lidvar mitzva, shebbischar layla achat shekkedamatta bechira litzira,

a: Zachta vekadma arbaa dorot beyisrael lammalchut.
Mishna haishsha shennadra benazir, vehifrisha et behemtah, veachar kach hefer lah baalah. im shello hayta habbehema — tetze vetire baeder.
Veim shellah hayta habbehema, hachattat — tamut, veola — tikrav ola, shelamim — tikrav shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lechem.
Hayu lah maot setumin — yippelu lindava. maot meforashin, deme chattat — yelchu leyam hammelach. lo nehenin, velo moalin bahen.
Deme ola — yaviu ola, umoalin bahen. deme shelamim — yaviu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veen teunin lechem.
Gemara man tena devaal la mishtabad la? amar rav chisda: rabbanan hi. dei salka datach rabbi yehuda hi, ammay tetze vetire baeder? ha mishtabad la.
Detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: adam mevi korban ashir al ishto.
Vechen kol korbenoteha shehi chayyevet, shekkach katav lah: "kol achrayut deit lich alay min kadmat dena".
Rava amar: afillu tema rabbi yehuda, ki meshabad la — bemilleta ditzricha la, bemilleta dela tzericha la — la.
Ikka deamri: man tanna? amar rav chisda: rabbi yehuda hi. vechi meshabad la — bemilleta ditzricha la, bemilleta dela tzericha lah — la. dei rabbanan — la meshabad la kelal.
Ella hechi dame dimshabad la — kegon deakneyay la, vechevan deakne la — have denafsha.
b: Rava amar: afillu tema rabbanan, ki makne la — name bemilleta ditzricha la, bemilleta dela tzericha la — la makne la.

Im shellah hayta behemtah, chattat — tamut, veola — tikrav. hi mena la? haamrat: ma shekkanta ishsha kana balah! amar rav pappa: shekkimmetzatta meissatah. ibbaet ema: deakni la acher, vaamar la: "al menat sheen levalech reshut bahen".

Haola — tikrav ola, vehashshelamim — tikrav kulei. amar leh shemuel laavu bar ihi: la tittev al karaych ad deamrat li hada milleta: veellu hen arbaa elim sheenan teunin lechem: shello, veshellah, veshelleachar hammita, veshelleachar kappara.
Shellah — ha daamaran. shello — ditnan: haish maddir et beno benazir, veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir. gillach, o sheggillechuhu kerovim, micha, o shemmichuhu kerovim.

Hayu lo maot setumin — yippelu lindava. maot meforashin, deme chattat — yelchu leyam hammelach, deme ola — yaviu ola, umoalin bahen. deme shelamim — yaviu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lechem.
Shelleachar mita menalan, detanya: hammafrish maot linziruto — lo nehenin velo moalin bahen, mippene shehen reuyin lehavi bechullan shelamim.

Met, vehayu lo maot setumim — yippelu lindava. maot meforashin, deme chattat — yolich leyam hammelach, lo nehenin velo moalin. deme ola — yaviu ola, umoalin bahen. deme shelamim — yaviu shelamim, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lechem.
Shelleachar kappara — sevara hu, shelleachar hammita may taam — dela chazya lechappara, shelleachar kappara name — ha la chazya lechappara.
Vetu lekka? vehaikka: ushear kol shalme nazir sheshshechatan shello kemitzvatan — kesherim, velo olin labbealim leshum chova, veneechalin leyom echad, veenan teunin lo lechem velo zeroa!
Kemitzvatan ka chashev, shello kemitzvatan la ka chashev.

a: Vahalo deme chattat meoravin bahen? amar rabbi yochanan: halacha hi benazir. resh lakish amar: "lechol nidrehem ulechol nidvotam", hattora amra: motar neder yehe lindava.
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar: halacha hi benazir, ammetu lehachi setumin — in, meforashin — la. ella leresh lakish "lechol nidrehem ulechol nidvotam", may irya setumin? afillu meforashin!
Amar rava: meforashin la matzet amrat, kevar paska tanna deve rabbi yishmael: "rak kodashecha asher yihyu lecha unedarecha" — bevalde kadashim uvitmuratam hakkatuv medabber.
Ma takkanatan — "tissa uvata el hammakom asher yivchar Adonai". yachol yaalem levet habbechira, veyimna mehem mayim umazon bishvil sheyyamutu, talmud lomar: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam".

Lomar lach: kederech sheatta noheg baola — nehog bitmuratah, kederech sheatta noheg bashshelamim — nehog bevaldehem. yachol af velad chattat utemurat asham ken, — talmud lomar: "rak", divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "asham hu" — bahavayayto yehe.

Asham name hilcheta gemiri lah: kol sheillu bechattat meta, beasham roe!
Ella: i mehilcheta, hava amena: hilcheta, vei akreyveh — la lichayyayv aleh velo kelum, ka mashma lan kera dei makrev leh — kaem aleh baase.
Rabbi akiva omer eno tzarich, hare hu omer "asham hu" — bahavayayto yehe. lema li kera? gemara gemirin la: kol shebbechattat meta — beasham roe!
Hachi name, vechi ata kera — lidrav. deamar rav huna amar rav: asham shennittak liriyyay, ushechato leshem ola — kasher.
Tama denittak, ha lo nittak — la. deamar kera "hu" — bahavayayto yehe.
